critique.problem: The chart makes a claim the data cannot prove.
critique.repair: Only describe what the data shows.

critique.problem: The y-axis does not start at zero.
The y-axis does not show the percent unit.
critique.repair: Add percent (%) to the y-axis label.

critique.problem: The programs are only separated by color.
critique.repair: Use color and another visual difference.

critique.problem: Extra decoration distracts from the data.

question: How does our goal success change across follow-up visits for each program?
audience: The program coordinator, who will use the chart to compare the two programs at hand
intended_claim: Goal achievement increased across follow-up visits in both programs.
y_measure: Percent of patients who met the 150-minute weekly exercise goal.
grain: One row represents one program at one follow-up visit.
text_alternative: Line chart showing the percent of patients meeting the exercise goal across the four follow-up visits. Goal achievement did in fact increase in both programs. At visit 4, Center-based was 79 and Home-based was 70%, a 9-point difference.These results are not conclusive of the results or show that either program caused the difference.
